discord.serverImportSeparateFromAccountLink: Server import pulls channels and roles from a Discord server. Your personal Discord link in Settings is separate and doesn't replace import.
discord.oauthCallbackUrlIntro: If you were asked for a callback link (for example when setting up Discord for Echo), use this:
discord.mergeHintFull: We updated your Echo profile from Discord where we could (name, picture, and more when available).
discord.mergeHintPartial: Your Echo username and email stay as they are. We keep these Discord details for reference and display.
discord.profileImportPromptBody: Your Discord account is linked. We can copy your Discord avatar, banner, display name, and bio into your Echo profile. You can change them anytime in Settings.

oauthErrors.not_configured: Discord linking isn't turned on for this Echo server yet. Ask an admin to enable it.
oauthErrors.missing_encryption_key: This Echo server isn't set up to store Discord safely yet. Ask an admin.
oauthErrors.access_denied: You cancelled the Discord prompt. You can try again anytime.
oauthErrors.invalid_callback: That Discord sign-in didn't finish. Try connecting again.
oauthErrors.bad_state: That sign-in took too long or the page was refreshed. Try connecting again.
oauthErrors.no_database: Echo can't reach its database right now. Try again in a moment.
oauthErrors.token_exchange: Discord couldn't finish signing you in. Try again.
oauthErrors.discord_me: We couldn't read your Discord profile. Try again.
oauthErrors.discord_already_linked: That Discord account is already linked to someone else on Echo.
oauthErrors.not_available: That isn't available right now. Try again later.
oauthErrors.user_gone: You're signed out. Sign back in, then try linking Discord again.
oauthErrors.merge_failed: We couldn't update your Echo profile from Discord. Try again or contact support.
oauthErrors.encrypt_failed: We couldn't store your Discord connection securely. Try again later.
oauthErrors.persist_failed: We couldn't save your Discord link. Try again.
oauthErrors.discord_not_linked: No Echo account is linked to that Discord yet. Create an account and link Discord in Settings, or sign in with your username and password.
oauthErrors.discord_login_mfa: This account uses two-factor authentication. Sign in with your password and authenticator code instead.
oauthErrors.oauth_email_conflict: An account with that email already exists, but it isn't linked to this Discord account. Sign in with your password, then link Discord in Settings.
oauthErrors.discord_no_email: Discord didn't share an email with Echo. Allow the email permission when Discord asks, or create an account with email and password instead.
oauthErrors.session_restore_failed: Discord sign-in finished, but Echo couldn't start your session. Try signing in again. If this keeps happening, check that the app URL matches your API (same host/port as in DISCORD_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI / ECHO_APP_PUBLIC_URL).
oauthErrors.desktop_handoff_failed: Echo couldn't complete sign-in from the browser. Try Discord sign-in again, or use username and password.
oauthErrors.unknown: Something went wrong while connecting Discord. Try again.

google.oauthCallbackUrlIntro: Echo opens Google's consent screen. After you approve, your Google account is linked to Echo for sign-in and YouTube. See Settings → Legal → Privacy policy (Section 14) for how we use Google user data.
google.mergeHintFull: Echo can use your Google name and photo where your profile allows it.
google.mergeHintPartial: Google is linked for sign-in. Profile fields from Google are only applied when you choose to use them.
google.youtubeRequiresLinkHint: Link your Google account here first, then connect YouTube in Settings → YouTube using the same Google account that owns your channel.

oauthErrors.missing_encryption_key: This Echo server isn't set up to store Google safely yet. Ask an admin.

oauthErrors.google_me: We couldn't read your Google profile. Try again.
oauthErrors.google_already_linked: That Google account is already linked to someone else on Echo.
oauthErrors.not_available: That isn't available right now. Try again later.
oauthErrors.user_gone: You're signed out. Sign back in, then try linking Google again.
oauthErrors.merge_failed: We couldn't update your Echo profile from Google. Try again or contact support.
oauthErrors.encrypt_failed: We couldn't store your Google connection securely. Try again later.
oauthErrors.persist_failed: We couldn't save your Google link. Try again.

youtube.oauthCallbackUrlIntro: Echo opens Google's consent screen. After you approve, you return here with your channel linked for stage live streaming.
youtube.requiresGoogleLinkHint: Connect Google in Settings → Google before linking a YouTube channel.
youtube.nativeConnectionBlurb: Echo creates the live broadcast and sends video over RTMP. Requires Google + YouTube linking and live streaming on your channel.
youtube.streamKeyBlurb: Paste the stream key from YouTube Studio → Go live → Stream. Echo sends video to that ingest URL. You start and manage the broadcast in YouTube yourself.
youtube.streamKeyNeverShownAgain: After you save, Echo encrypts your key and never shows it again. Revoke here anytime to replace it.
youtube.streamKeySwitchToNativeHint: You can switch anytime to a full YouTube channel connection above for automatic broadcasts and watch links in Echo.
youtube.stageLiveStreamingUnavailableHint: Live streaming to YouTube isn't configured on this Echo server yet (LiveKit egress). Go live from a stage won't work until an admin enables the egress service and sets LIVEKIT_EGRESS_ENABLED=true.
youtube.stageStreamKeyLiveHint: Echo is sending video to your saved stream key. Start or end the broadcast in YouTube Studio — watch links are not created by Echo in this mode.
youtube.goLiveModalSubtitle: Echo sends your stage program feed to YouTube over RTMP. Set how the broadcast appears before you start.
youtube.goLiveThumbnailHint: Echo does not upload custom thumbnails yet. Your linked channel avatar is shown as a preview — change the thumbnail in YouTube Studio after you go live.
youtube.goLiveStreamKeyModalHint: Privacy and watch links are managed in YouTube Studio when using a saved stream key.
youtube.goLiveDescriptionPlaceholder: Tell viewers what this stream is about (optional)
